description.zh: 关热点时关射频、降频、关核心、关蓝牙，熄屏后深度休眠，开热点恢复；CPU 设置可关闭核心（OFF，小核可保留 1/2/4 个）；USB 可关闭（仅充电，或连充电也关闭并可插线深度休眠）
description.en: Radio, CPU and Bluetooth off while the hotspot is off, and deep sleep with the screen dark; OFF for CPU cores in CPU settings; USB can be turned off (charge only, or no charging either and deep sleep plugged in)

label.zh: 关闭蜂窝（最省电，收不到短信电话）
label.en: Cellular off (least power, no SMS or calls)

label.zh: 只断数据（短信电话正常）
label.en: Data off only (SMS and calls work)

label.zh: 射频关闭时暂停 SIM 状态轮询
label.en: Pause SIM polling while radio is off

note.zh: 更省电；期间状态栏不显示运营商
note.en: Saves power; no operator in the status bar meanwhile

label.zh: 关热点时 CPU / GPU 锁最低频率
label.en: Lowest CPU / GPU clocks with the hotspot off

note.zh: 开热点时恢复；期间屏幕操作会变慢
note.en: Restored with the hotspot; the screen is slower meanwhile

label.zh: 关热点时关闭 CPU 核心
label.en: CPU cores with the hotspot off

note.zh: 开热点时全部恢复；若关核心导致死机，下次开机自动改回全部保留
note.en: All back with the hotspot; a crash turns this off at the next boot

label.zh: 屏幕亮着时临时恢复全速
label.en: Full speed while the screen is lit

note.zh: 亮屏 1 秒内放开核心和频率，熄屏 5 秒后恢复限制
note.en: Cores and clocks back within 1 s; limits again 5 s after it goes dark

label.zh: 熄屏时暂停屏幕电源监视
label.en: Pause the screen power watcher while dark

note.zh: 熄屏 5 秒后暂停每秒 10 次的背光检查，亮屏后恢复
note.en: Its 10 checks a second stop 5 s after the screen goes dark, and go on when it lights

label.zh: 无设备连接时自动关热点（分钟）

note.zh: 0 为不自动关；USB 连着电脑时不关
note.en: 0: never; not while a computer is on USB

note.zh: 有蓝牙设备连着时不关；开热点时恢复
note.en: Not while a device is connected; back with the hotspot

label.en: Deep sleep with the hotspot off

note.zh: 熄屏后系统真正休眠，按键、充电器、基带唤醒；插着 USB 或充电时不休眠；系统装在 SD 卡上时暂不休眠
note.en: The system suspends with the screen dark; keys, the charger and the modem wake it. Never on USB or while charging, and not yet with the system on an SD card

label.zh: 熄屏后多久开始休眠（秒）
label.en: Sleep after the screen is dark for (s)

label.zh: 蜂窝射频开着时也休眠
label.en: Deep sleep with the cellular radio on too

note.zh: 默认只在射频关闭后休眠（关热点时：关闭蜂窝）；射频开着时基带每隔几秒唤醒一次，反复醒睡可能比不睡更费电
note.en: By default only with the radio off (mode: cellular off): with it on, the modem wakes the system every few seconds

note.zh: 基带唤醒（短信、来电）时至少 15 秒
note.en: At least 15 s after a modem wake (SMS, call)

label.zh: 射频关闭时熄屏刷新间隔
label.en: Dark-screen refresh with the radio off

label.zh: 关热点后延迟断开（分钟）
